# Cedar Rapids Web Design

> Professional web design and development services based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

## About

Cedar Rapids Web Design is run by James Welbes, a web developer specializing in custom WordPress websites, performance-focused web design, and SEO-ready sites for small businesses in Cedar Rapids and the surrounding area.

## Services

- Custom WordPress website design and development
- Website redesigns and rebuilds
- Performance optimization and Core Web Vitals improvement
- SEO-friendly markup and site structure
- Contact form setup and email integration
- Mobile-friendly, responsive design

## Who We Help

Small businesses, local service providers, and entrepreneurs in Cedar Rapids, Iowa and surrounding areas who need a professional web presence.

## Contact

To hire James or request a free consultation, fill out the contact form at https://cedarrapidswebdesign.com or email james@cedarrapidswebdesign.com

## Technology

Sites are built using WordPress with Automatic CSS and Etch for maintainable, scalable code. Hosting recommendations provided on request.
